results.name: Polynomial.monic_restriction
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem monic_restriction {p : R[X]} : Monic (restriction p) ↔ Monic p := by
  simp only [Monic, leadingCoeff, natDegree_restriction]
  rw [← @coeff_restriction _ _ p]
  exact ⟨fun H => by rw [H, OneMemClass.coe_one], fun H => Subtype.coe_injective H⟩

results.name: Mathlib.Tactic.ComputeDegree.tacticMonicity!
results.source_text:
macro "monicity!" : tactic =>
  `(tactic| (apply monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one <;> compute_degree!))
results.docstring:
`monicity` tries to solve a goal of the form `Monic f`.
It converts the goal into a goal of the form `natDegree f ≤ n` and one of the form `f.coeff n = 1`
and calls `compute_degree` on those two goals.

The variant `monicity!` starts like `monicity`, but calls `compute_degree!` on the two side-goals.

/-- `Polynomial R` is the type of univariate polynomials over `R`,
denoted as `R[X]` within the `Polynomial` namespace.

Polynomials should be seen as (semi-)rings with the additional constructor `X`.
The embedding from `R` is called `C`. -/

structure Polynomial (R : Type*) [Semiring R] where ofFinsupp ::

results.name: Polynomial.monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one
results.source_text:
theorem monic_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_eq_one (n : ℕ) (pn : p.natDegree ≤ n) (p1 : p.coeff n = 1) :
    Monic p := by
  unfold Monic
  nontriviality
  refine (congr_arg _ <| natDegree_eq_of_le_of_coeff_ne_zero pn ?_).trans p1
  exact ne_of_eq_of_ne p1 one_ne_zero

results.name: gcdMonoidOfGCD
results.source_text:
/-- Define `GCDMonoid` on a structure just from the `gcd` and its properties. -/
@[implicit_reducible]
noncomputable def gcdMonoidOfGCD [DecidableEq α] (gcd : α → α → α)
    (gcd_dvd_left : ∀ a b, gcd a b ∣ a) (gcd_dvd_right : ∀ a b, gcd a b ∣ b)
    (dvd_gcd : ∀ {a b c}, a ∣ c → a ∣ b → a ∣ gcd c b) : GCDMonoid α :=
  { gcd
    gcd_dvd_left
    gcd_dvd_right
    dvd_gcd := fun {_ _ _} => dvd_gcd
    lcm := fun a b =>
      if a = 0 then 0 else Classical.choose ((gcd_dvd_left a b).trans (Dvd.intro b rfl))
    gcd_mul_lcm := fun a b => by
      split_ifs with a0
      · rw [mul_zero, a0, zero_mul]
      · rw [← Classical.choose_spec ((gcd_dvd_left a b).trans (Dvd.intro b rfl))]
    lcm_zero_left := fun _ => if_pos rfl
    lcm_zero_right := fun a => by
      split_ifs with a0
      · rfl
      have h := (Classical.choose_spec ((gcd_dvd_left a 0).trans (Dvd.intro 0 rfl))).symm
      have a0' : gcd a 0 ≠ 0 := by
        contrapose a0
        rw [← associated_zero_iff_eq_zero, ← a0]
        exact associated_of_dvd_dvd (dvd_gcd (dvd_refl a) (dvd_zero a)) (gcd_dvd_left _ _)
      apply Or.resolve_left (mul_eq_zero.1 _) a0'
      rw [h, mul_zero] }
results.docstring: Define `GCDMonoid` on a structure just from the `gcd` and its properties.

results.name: Finset.extract_gcd'
results.source_text:
theorem extract_gcd' (f g : β → α) (hs : ∃ x, x ∈ s ∧ f x ≠ 0)
    (hg : ∀ b ∈ s, f b = s.gcd f * g b) : s.gcd g = 1 := by
  rw [← normalize_gcd, normalize_eq_one, ← associated_one_iff_isUnit]
  refine .of_mul_left (.symm <| .trans ?_ (gcd_mul_left' ..)) .rfl (a := s.gcd f) ?_
  · simp [← gcd_congr rfl hg]
  contrapose! hs
  exact s.gcd_eq_zero_iff.1 hs
